mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 persons signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 600.0 and RSAFS > 350000 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of rising GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% per annum combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 9.5% and decline in non-farm payrolls below 129,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5 and PAYEMS < 129000, or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 90.0 combined with a rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates a dual shock of supply contraction and labor market weakness, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 9.5, or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
